sc.title: Side canvas
sc.sub: The empty space left and right of the page on wide computer screens.
sc.note: Zones show only on a computer with a mouse, only where the space beside the page is wide enough, never over the page. Phones and tablets never show or load them.
sc.readOnly: You can see this page. Changing it needs the permission to change page layouts.

master.title: Side canvas on the shop
master.on: On: customers on wide computer screens see your zones that are switched on.
master.off: Off: the shop looks as it does today. Your zones are kept; draw them and check the map first.
master.ask: Turn the side canvas on? After Save, customers on wide computer screens will see your zones. Turn it on only after you approved the map below.

zones.title: Zones
zones.sub: Each zone sits on the left or the right, on the pages and days you choose.
zones.none: No zone yet. Add one on the left or the right.

sc.addLeft: Add a zone on the left
sc.addRight: Add a zone on the right
sc.hideNote: A zone is never deleted: switch it off to hide it. A new zone and a copy start hidden.

mode.float: Floating: stays in view, drifts gently

style.full: Straight on the page, no frame

f.name: Name in this list
f.imageHint: An https:// address or a shop path. Keep a picture small (about 150 KB).
f.hrefHint: Empty = the product's or category's own page. A shop path like /collections/polo, or a full https:// address.
f.text: Words (a line under the picture, or the offer button's words)
f.catsHint: Pick none to show it on every category page.
f.weightNote: The zone scales down to the room each screen gives and hides when even half its size does not fit.

map.title: Approval map
map.subOn: Where each zone that is switched on sits on two common computer screens.
map.subOff: Check where each zone would sit before you turn the side canvas on. Nothing changes on the shop while it is off.
map.note: Grey band = header; the middle box = the page's content. Drawn from what you see above, before Save.
map.legend: The zones on the map, by number

sc.unsaved: Unsaved changes: the shop still shows the saved side canvas.

err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not right. Check the zones' addresses, sizes and days.
err.STALE: Someone saved a moment ago. Reload the page.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change page layouts.
